parts.text: Aventuras de Sherlock Holmes IV\. — El misterio del valle de Boscombe {{#desayuno q:desayuno|Estábamos desayunando una mañana, [[esposa|mi mujer]] y yo, cuando la doncella trajo un telegrama.}} Era de [[holmes|Sherlock Holmes]] y decía así: «¿Tiene un par de días libres? {{#boscombe e:holmes p:boscombe q:boscombe|Me han telegrafiado del oeste de Inglaterra por la tragedia del [[boscombe|valle de Boscombe]].}} Me alegraré si viene conmigo. Aire y paisaje perfectos. {{#tren e:holmes q:tren|Salga de [[paddington|Paddington]] en el de las 11.15.»}} —¿Qué dices, querido? —dijo mi mujer, mirándome desde el otro lado de la mesa—. ¿Irás? —De veras no sé qué decir. Tengo una lista bastante larga. {{#anstruther e:esposa q:anstruther|—Oh, [[anstruther|Anstruther]] te haría el trabajo.}} Últimamente te veo un poco pálido. Creo que el cambio te sentaría bien, y siempre te interesan tanto los casos del señor Sherlock Holmes. {{#gane e:esposa q:gane|—Sería un ingrato si no me interesaran, viendo lo que gané con uno de ellos —respondí.}}

src_en.desayuno: We were seated at breakfast one morning, my wife and I, when the maid brought in a telegram.
src_en.boscombe: Have just been wired for from the west of England in connection with Boscombe Valley tragedy.
src_en.anstruther: Oh, Anstruther would do your work for you.
src_en.gane: I should be ungrateful if I were not, seeing what I gained through one of them
src_en.transformado: Sherlock Holmes was transformed when he was hot upon such a scent as this.
src_en.cejas: His brows were drawn into two hard black lines, while his eyes shone out from beneath them with a steely glitter.
src_en.caza: His nostrils seemed to dilate with a purely animal lust for the chase
src_en.lestrade_detras: Lestrade and I walked behind him, the detective indifferent and contemptuous, while I watched my friend with the interest which sprang from the conviction that every one of his actions was directed towards a definite end.
src_en.tres_junio: On June 3rd, that is, on Monday last, McCarthy left his house at Hatherley about three in the afternoon and walked down to the Boscombe Pool
